cook.title: Honey Chicken Thighs with Broccoli TEST
ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil, for the broccoli

slides.title: Gather Ingredients
slides.text: Get everything out before you start
uses: 1 tbsp olive oil, for the broccoli

slides.title: If Roasting Broccoli
slides.text: If roasting the broccoli, preheat oven to 425°F. Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper and cook in a cast iron pan.

slides.title: Add Chicken Broth
slides.text: Add the chicken broth and honey to the pan and let the chicken cook in the glaze until done.

slides.title: Toss Broccoli Florets
slides.text: Toss the broccoli florets with olive oil, salt, and pepper, and roast or pan-cook for about 8 minutes.
uses: 1 tbsp olive oil, for the broccoli

slides.title: Serve Glazed Chicken
slides.text: Serve the glazed chicken and broccoli together.

steps: If roasting the broccoli, preheat oven to 425°F. Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper and cook in a cast iron pan.
Add the chicken broth and honey to the pan and let the chicken cook in the glaze until done.
Toss the broccoli florets with olive oil, salt, and pepper, and roast or pan-cook for about 8 minutes.
Serve the glazed chicken and broccoli together.
